n: 4 Port Gigabit Unmanaged Harsh POE Switch

specs.label: Ports
specs.value: 4 × Gigabit PoE port,2 × Gigabit fiber optical port

specs.label: Long Range
specs.value: Ports 3 to 4: up to 300 m Long range performance may vary depend on camera model or cable condition.

specs.label: Port Isolation
specs.value: Ports 1 to 4: port isolation mode to improve network security.

specs.label: PoE Watchdog
specs.value: Ports 1 to 4: auto detect and restart the cameras that do not respond.
